verdict.rationale: Metorial has its own live, key-gated public REST API with a published OpenAPI spec, plus official TypeScript, Python, and Go SDKs covering sessions, providers, tool filters, and OAuth. Nothing shows full UI parity, though: API keys are created in the dashboard, and Workforce admin features such as portals, Magic Skills governance, and agent inspection appear only as UI features. missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, API coverage of Workforce/portal/skills administration, programmatic API-key management, independent corroboration of API completeness.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: the documented public REST API is live and key-gated exactly as the docs describe
